Gusic splits artist tags using character delimiters (/, ;, &) and word delimiters (feat., ft., vs., x). Word delimiters are matched case-insensitively.
"Extract Artists from Title" detects patterns like (feat. Artist) in song titles.
Backslash (\) can be used to escape character delimiters.
These preferences are used when Gusic edits a song’s artist metadata. They do not rescan or reprocess existing songs, and SAF imports keep the artist metadata read from the selected files.

Search existing open and closed issues to avoid duplicates.
Update to the latest Gusic version and confirm the problem still happens.
Restart the app and confirm the problem persists.
Try to reproduce it and write down the exact steps.

Copy these fields when something behaves incorrectly or crashes.

How nightlies differ from releases, and what to include when they break.
Nightly builds are generated from the latest commit and may contain unfinished changes, temporary bugs, or regressions. They are more experimental than official releases.
Access them from the repository\'s GitHub Actions workflow artifacts if available.

When reporting an issue from a nightly build, always mention that it happened on a nightly build, not on the official release. Include the build date, workflow run name or number, or commit SHA if possible. Also check if the same problem happens on the latest official release.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v010_whats_new
string-array.item: Added a Discover page to enable online features.

Split online and local entries: online pages perform online operations only, local pages perform local operations only. Tracks played from an online platform are attributed to the local platform but not stored offline; local operations remain available.
Added playlist import/export for LX Music.
Added custom music source and script import for LX Music.
Added song download for LX Music.
Added audio quality selection for LX Music.
Added login for LX Music.
Added playback caching for LX Music.
Added mini player lyrics display during song playback.
Added lyrics on the player page.
Added song sharing.
Added Traditional Chinese language.
More to explore on your own...

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v010_changes
string-array.item: Local search page is now hidden and disabled by default.
LRCLIB online lyrics are enabled by default and removed from first-launch selection; search no longer auto-selects the first result.
Theme style now follows the system by default.
Library navigation style selection has been removed from first-launch selection.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v011_whats_new
string-array.item: Adjusted the player page layout.
Added an in-app update checker to the About page.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v011_changes
string-array.item: Fixed a race condition when switching between multiple online sources.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261008_whats_new
string-array.item: The local library now imports music through the system file picker (SAF) instead of MediaStore scanning; imported files persist across restarts.
QQ Music login now supports web login in addition to QR code login.
App identity, name, and icons are now Gusic throughout.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261008_changes
string-array.item: Playlist export files now carry a Gusic playlist marker; old PixelPlayer exports still import.
Internal cleanup and documentation updates after the development-tooling migration.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261010_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ Music login now loads your profile, liked songs, and playlists after signing in.
Online platform names are now shown in full (QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou Music, Kuwo Music) instead of abbreviations.
The About page header icon now matches the new Gusic branding.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261010_changes
string-array.item: Released APKs are named gusic-<abi>-[v<version>].apk.
Platform login cookies are excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261011_whats_new
string-array.item: About page header now shows the app icon foreground style.
All platforms are listed directly on the account login page.
QQ Music login opens the web page login directly.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v261011_changes
string-array.item: Discover now defaults to QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou, Kuwo order.
Platforms can be hidden in the reorder sheet; logged-out ones are hidden by default and QQ Music always stays visible.

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101101_whats_new
string-array.item: Tapping any song in a playlist or chart now queues the whole list in order and starts from that song
Fixed QQ Music search returning no results
Fixed QQ Music account playlists all showing as liked songs

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101101_changes
string-array.item: Lyrics now always show synced mode; the synced/static toggle is removed and romanization defaults to off
Default launch tab is now Discover
Library navigation is fixed to compact pill + grid; the tab-row mode and its setting are removed

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101102_whats_new
string-array.item: Further fixed QQ Music search returning no results
Play screen now has a single three-mode cycle button: list loop, single loop and shuffle
Cycle and favorite buttons now sit left of the lyrics button with a matching style

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101102_changes
string-array.item: Cycle and favorite controls removed from the lyrics more sheet and the queue sheet
Album cover is now a taller 1:1 square and lower controls moved down
Mini player now shows the artist beside the song title

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101103_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ Music songs can now be favorited and synced to your QQ liked list
Playback notification: close button removed, cycle-mode button added in front
Lyrics more sheet: font size control added
Player cover is now a true 1:1 square filling the freed space, lower controls shifted down

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101103_changes
string-array.item: Chart name chips no longer get clipped and adapt to text width
Removed shuffle, filter and sort buttons from the Mine page
Completely removed the bookmarks feature
Remember shuffle state and show queue history are now on by default

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101104_whats_new
string-array.item: Player page: bottom gap eliminated, controls now sit flush at the bottom edge
Favoriting QQ Music songs auto-resolves missing song info, no more missing-info error
Notification buttons respond instantly: icon switches first, rolls back on failure
Starting new playback auto-opens the player page (resume and track change excluded)

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101104_changes
string-array.item: Chart chips no longer hidden behind the right action capsule
Mine page: locate button removed; action row takes no space when empty
Mine page: Folders category removed, Liked moved to first
Playback notification cycle-mode button stays in front

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101105_whats_new
string-array.item: Player bottom gap truly fixed: controls now sit flush at the screen bottom
QQ favorite resolution reinforced: matches by song name and artist before failing
Notification cycle-mode button moved to the very front, before transport controls
Player top bar now shows the colored platform tag instead of "Now Playing"

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101105_changes
string-array.item: "Charts" module button label no longer clipped
Lyrics font scale: 100% now equals the old 70% size, overall smaller
Lyrics alignment defaults to center
Removed the settings entry from the Discover top bar

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101106_whats_new
string-array.item: Player page: expanded layout now wraps its height, all components shift down to close the bottom gap
QQ favorites: requests now carry the web sign; failures show a business code for diagnosis
Playback notification: previous-track button restored, cycle-mode button stays in front
Play/pause button background now matches the cycle-mode button color

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101106_changes
string-array.item: "Show file info" now defaults to off in Settings
Removed the settings entry from the Home top bar
Mine page: Playlists category moved to second
"Charts" module button widened so its label shows in full

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101107_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ favorites: rewritten onto the client protocol endpoint with a new signature, fixing the 80105 rejection
QQ search: requests now carry login state and signature with an automatic retry, far fewer empty results
Notification buttons reordered to previous, play/pause, next, cycle, favorite; previous no longer vanishes in repeat-one
Discover page: "Mine" stays available on every platform, showing a login prompt and entry when signed out

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101107_changes
string-array.item: Player page: play/pause button color distinct from previous/next again

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101108_whats_new
string-array.item: QQ favorites: switched to the web-mode request (g_tk token hash), third attempt after 80105/500003
Player page: play/pause now shares the exact background of the cycle/favorite/lyrics chips
Mine page: icon now matches the Discover "Mine" module; Albums and Artists categories removed
Mine page: Songs renamed to History, sorted by recently played first

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101108_changes
string-array.item: Notification order kept as previous, play/pause, next, cycle, favorite (system slot limit)

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101109_whats_new
string-array.item: Notification: cycle moved to the front — order is now cycle, previous, play/pause, next, favorite
History: a song jumps to the top the moment it starts playing, no need to finish first
Player page: opening animation no longer jumps at the end; cover is exactly 1:1; more bottom breathing room
Mine page: top tab title font reduced

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101109_changes
string-array.item: QQ favorites: fourth request recipe (token embedded in the hybrid comm), after 80105
Previous-track notification button restored as the native system button, stays visible in repeat-one

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101110_whats_new
string-array.item: Notification: previous is back — order is cycle, previous, play/pause, next, favorite
Discover: search box moved to a full-width row at the top; only Mine and Charts modules remain
Discover: search categories now include Playlists (songs/albums/artists/playlists); pasting a link or ID opens the playlist directly
Discover: browsing modules hide while searching, results hide before searching; the leading icon becomes a back button in search mode

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101110_changes
string-array.item: Root cause of the vanishing previous button: Media3 skips the native previous when a custom back-slot button exists — now inserted explicitly with a semantic action

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101201_whats_new
string-array.item: Leaderboards redesigned as a menu grid: two board cards per row, each showing the board name and its top three tracks; tap a card to open the board
The Liked category is now two-level: level one lists this app plus each logged-in platform, level two shows that source’s liked songs; platforms you are not logged into are hidden

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101201_changes
string-array.item: Favoriting and unfavoriting no longer show success toasts; only failures are reported

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101202_whats_new
string-array.item: Liked entries: each platform now shows its liked-song count; the local entry is renamed Liked; both levels get a top back button

string-array.name: presentation_batch_g_changelog_v26101202_changes
string-array.item: Notification no longer shows lyrics: song title on the first line, artist below; the notification-lyrics setting is removed
Platform liked lists no longer show the source tag; the local liked list keeps it
